entries.en: Slowfix needs your help in solving a problem.
entries.fr: Slowfix a besoin de vous pour résoudre un problème.
entries.ja: イディルシャイアのスローフィクスは、問題解決に冒険者の力を借りたいようだ。

entries.en: Idyllshire is to be a new, free nation─a utopia for goblins and any who wish to join them. But founding a nation is not without monetary costs. Slowfix explains that, since taxing the citizens of their hard-earned gil would fly in the face of all that this fledgling nation stands for, funds are raised through rental of vital tools and equipment. Unfortunately, a goblin has borrowed a pickaxe and left Idyllshire without returning it. Find this ungracious goblin and retrieve the pickaxe.
entries.fr: Slowfix souhaiterait que vous rendiez visite au Gobelin gaffeur qui se trouve au quartier des Fabricateurs, dans l'Arrière-pays dravanien. Il lui a prêté une pioche qui ne lui a toujours pas été rendue.
entries.ja: スローフィクスから、貸し出した道具を返さないゴブリン族から事情を聞いてくるよう頼まれた。低地ドラヴァニアのシャーレアン工匠街で「粗忽者のゴブリン族」を探そう。

entries.en: You find the goblin, but she is under attack by tarantula hawks! Slay these beasts and rescue the defenseless goblin such that you may ascertain the whereabouts of the missing pickaxe.
entries.fr: Vous avez retrouvé le Gobelin gaffeur, qui était attaqué par des monstres. Vous devez le secourir !
entries.ja: 襲われていた粗忽者のゴブリン族を見つけた。妨害を退けて、「粗忽者のゴブリン族」を救助しよう。
entries.frMacro: Vous avez retrouvé le Gobelin gaffeur, qui était attaqué par des monstres. Vous devez le secourir<nbsp>!

entries.en: The beleaguered goblin thanks you before explaining that she forgot about the rental pickaxe she borrowed before leaving on her journey. While she can't return to Idyllshire herself to return the pickaxe, she entrusts it to you, requesting that you return it to its rightful owner in her stead. Go back to Idyllshire and give the pickaxe back to Drydox.
